one_line_description: Salesforce is a CRM and Sales platform that offers an AI agent toolkit through its Agentforce and AIforce features.
HubSpot is a CRM and Sales platform with an API for integration and an AI agent toolkit through its Agent Hub.
Pipedrive is a CRM and Sales tool with a REST API and OAuth 2.0 authentication. It offers a free API access with all plans and has a sandbox environment for testing.
Attio is a CRM platform for sales and revenue teams, offering a REST API, App SDK, and MCP server for integration and automation.
Twenty is an open-source CRM platform with a robust API and SDK for building custom apps and AI agents.
Podio is a CRM and Sales platform with a robust API for integration and automation.
Zoho CRM offers an official MCP server for AI agents, using OAuth 2.0 authentication.
Close is a CRM and Sales tool that offers an API for integrations and AI agents.
Copper is a CRM and Sales tool that offers an API for integration with AI agents.
DealCloud provides a comprehensive API for CRM and Sales, including authentication, SDKs, and MCP tools.
Zendesk is a support and helpdesk platform with AI capabilities, including AI agents and Copilot.
Intercom offers an AI agent (Fin) and a helpdesk platform with an API and MCP server.
Freshdesk offers AI-powered customer service with a REST API and MCP server for integrating with AI agents.

Front is a customer service platform with an API that can be used to build integrations and automate customer support. It offers a developer portal with documentation, authentication, and a sandbox environment.
Pylon is a support platform that uses AI to assist agents and provides an API for integration and automation.
LiveAgent is a help desk and live chat software with AI agents and live chat, offering a platform for AI agents, customer support experts, answer assistants, and human handovers.
Plain is a support infrastructure platform that allows teams and agents to work together, manage customer conversations, and build custom workflows.
Help Scout is an AI-driven support platform with an API for integrating and automating customer support.
Gorgias is a support and helpdesk platform with an API for developers to build custom integrations and tools.
Gladly is an AI-powered support and helpdesk platform that can be integrated with an AI-agent toolkit using its REST API.
Slack is an AI work platform and productivity tool that integrates with various apps and agents.
Twilio offers a comprehensive platform for communications and messaging, including SMS, voice, and email. It provides APIs for developers to integrate these services into their applications.
Zoho Cliq is a team chat and collaboration app with channels, voice and video calls, file sharing, bots, and workflow automation.
Lark is a communication and messaging platform with a robust API ecosystem, including an MCP server for AI agent integration.
Pumble is a free business communication and team messaging software with an API for integrations and an MCP server for AI agents.
Discord is a communication platform with a robust API for bots and companion apps.

Telegram offers multiple APIs for developers, including Bot API, Telegram API, and Gateway API. The Bot API is free and suitable for building bots, while the Telegram API and Gateway API require registration and are open for customization.
WhatsApp Business API can be used to build an AI-agent toolkit with a public API, OAuth2 authentication, and a wide range of features.
Aircall is a cloud-based contact center platform with an AI-powered customer communications platform, offering both team-led and AI-led customer conversations.

Vonage provides a suite of APIs for communications and messaging, with authentication methods including Basic Auth and JWT. It offers a MCP server for AI assistants, providing tools for documentation search, code generation, and troubleshooting.
Meta Ads is a comprehensive marketing platform that allows developers to automate and manage ad campaigns across Meta products using the Marketing API.
LinkedIn Ads API allows for programmatic management and reporting of LinkedIn advertising campaigns, with access gated through OAuth 2.0.
GoHighLevel is a CRM platform with an API for integrations and automation. It supports OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens for authentication.
Mailchimp provides a robust API for building integrations and automations, including tools for managing campaigns, lists, templates, reports, and automations.
Klaviyo is a marketing and analytics platform that provides an API for developers to integrate with their services.
systeme.io is a marketing and email automation platform that offers an API for integration and automation.

Pinterest offers an API for developers to integrate with Pinterest, including creating and managing pins, boards, and ads. It supports OAuth2 for authentication and has a public API for self-serve access.
Threads API allows developers to automate posting, managing replies, and accessing insights on Meta's Threads platform.
SendGrid is a marketing and email service provider owned by Twilio, offering an API for email delivery and a Marketing Campaigns editor for opt-in lists.
Shopify is an ecommerce platform that allows developers to build apps and extend its functionality. It provides an API for authentication and various tools for managing store data.
WooCommerce provides a REST API for managing products, orders, customers, and other entities. It supports authentication via API keys and offers a wide range of endpoints for CRUD operations.
BigCommerce offers a suite of APIs for building and managing online stores, products, catalogs, orders, customers, checkouts, payments, and shipping.
Salesforce Commerce Cloud provides an API for developers to interact with its services, including authentication via OAuth 2.0 and a public API for accessing various functionalities.
Magento (Adobe Commerce) is an e-commerce platform with a REST API and an MCP server for AI integration.
Squarespace provides a robust API for building custom applications and integrations, including commerce management, website customization, and more.
Gumroad provides an API for managing products, sales, and users, with OAuth2 authentication and webhooks.
Amazon Selling Partner API provides tools for accessing Amazon SP-API functionality through a standardized interface.

FanBasis (now Commas) is a platform for online creators and entrepreneurs to create and sell products, including courses, webinars, and communities. It offers a suite of tools for payments, funnels, courses, and payouts.
DataForSEO is a comprehensive SEO and data analysis platform with a RESTful API and MCP server options.
SE Ranking provides an API for SEO and data analysis, with authentication via API key and a public API surface.
Ahrefs provides an API for data and SEO, with MCP support for AI assistants.

MrScraper is a web scraping platform that offers an API for programmatically accessing its services, including scraping HTML, Markdown, screenshots, and web search. It supports authentication via API tokens and offers an MCP server for AI agents.
Apify is a platform for building and running web scraping and automation tools, with an MCP server for AI agents.
Firecrawl is a web data API for AI agents, offering search, scrape, parse, crawl, map, and interact functionalities.
Bright Data offers an AI-agent toolkit through its MCP server and API, providing web data access and scraping capabilities.
Sherlock is an open-source tool for finding usernames across social networks and websites.
Waterfall.io is a premium B2B data enrichment API that aggregates data from 30+ vendors, offering real-time email and phone verification.
Clay is a data, SEO, and scraping platform with a unique API and MCP server for AI-agent workflows.
GitHub provides a REST API for developers to interact with its platform, including authentication methods, API surface, and MCP server capabilities.
Vercel provides a REST API for interacting with its platform, including AI Gateway and access groups.
Netlify provides an API and MCP server for developers and agents to manage Netlify resources using natural language prompts.
Cloudflare provides a comprehensive API for developers to interact with its services, including authentication methods, API surface, and MCP server options.
Supabase is a developer platform that provides a full Postgres database, authentication, storage, and real-time functionality. It supports AI tools and has a CLI for development.
Neo4j is a graph database platform with APIs for authentication and querying.
Snowflake is a data platform that can be used to build AI agents through its API and MCP server.
Datadog is a platform for monitoring and observability that provides an API for integrating with AI agents.
Notion is a productivity and project management tool with a robust API for building tools and automations.
Airtable is a productivity and project management tool that can be used as an AI-agent toolkit through its API and MCP server.
Linear is a project management tool with a GraphQL API and SDK for building integrations and AI agents.
monday.com is a productivity and project management platform that supports AI agents through its API and MCP server.
ClickUp offers an API for integrating with AI agents through MCP servers or agent skills.
Coda provides a RESTful API and MCP server for AI integration.
Smartsheet is a productivity and project management tool with a robust API for integration and automation.
Stripe provides a public API and MCP server for AI agents.
Plaid provides a suite of financial APIs and tools, including an MCP server for integrating with AI assistants.
Binance provides an API for accessing cryptocurrency data and executing trades, with authentication via API keys and optional OAuth2.
Paygent Connect is a finance and fintech app that allows for AI agent monetization and cost tracking.
iPayX is a finance and fintech app with a neutral FX verification layer, offering API access for authentication and other services.
QuickBooks API requires OAuth 2.0 authentication and has specific rate limits and pricing tiers.
Xero offers an AI toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, and LangChain, along with a range of APIs and developer resources.

Brex offers an API for integrating with its finance and fintech services, including expense management, payments, and accounting. It supports OAuth2 for authentication and provides a public API for developers to build custom workflows.
Ramp is a finance automation platform with a developer API for accessing and managing account data, building applications, and automating financial workflows.
PitchBook provides a RESTful API for accessing private and public market data, requiring a paid, contract-based API key for access.

NotebookLM is a research and media-native AI tool that can be used to build AI agents and integrate generative AI into applications. It is currently only available through a private API and requires a paid plan.
Otter AI offers an API for transcription and conversation intelligence, with a public API and an MCP server available.

Fathom is an AI-powered note-taking service that captures, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls. It offers a free tier for individuals and paid plans for teams with CRM integration, delivering searchable, editable meeting notes and actionable insights.
Consensus is an AI research platform with an API and MCP server for AI-agent workflows.
Reducto is an agentic document platform for AI teams, offering APIs for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying, and editing documents.
Devin is an AI software engineer that can handle most tasks, excluding extremely difficult tasks. It can be integrated with an MCP server or used as agent skills.
Higgsfield offers an AI-agent toolkit with a CLI, API, and MCP server.

Mermaid CLI is a command-line tool for generating diagrams from Mermaid code. It can be used to create SVG, PNG, and PDF files. The Mermaid API provides programmatic access to its dataset, and there are MCP servers available for AI agents.
YouTube Transcript API provides programmatic access to extract and process transcripts from YouTube videos.
Grain is an AI notetaker that captures, enriches, and delivers meeting content to AI tools, offering both an MCP server and an API for integration.
